description: The agent must: (1) Read task_brief.json and the existing research/pipeline files to understand the business context. (2) Produce a valid outreach_kit.json with all five sections. For the ICP: must include industry (biotech), company size, job title (CEO/Founder), pain signals, AND a disqualifiers section with at least 2 entries — following the exact ICP template structure from SKILL.md. For the cold email: the body must be under 100 words (a proprietary hard rule from SKILL.md), must have a personalized hook referencing QuantumCell/Series A/Alex's LinkedIn post/VP Finance hiring, must use a non-generic specific subject line (not 'Quick question', 'Synergy', etc.), must end with a first-name-only sign-off (no 'CPA', 'LLC', company name, or title — per SKILL.md's 'first name only, no title, no company logo' rule), and must use a low-commitment ask ('10-min', 'worth a quick', etc. — NOT a 30-45 min call request). For the sequence: must have 5-6 touchpoints, must use the canonical day cadence (Day 1, 3, 5, 10, 14, 21 per SKILL.md), must span LinkedIn AND email channels, and the final touchpoint must include explicit 'clean exit' language ('last note from me', 'totally understand', 'happy to reconnect later') — a specific proprietary rule. For the LinkedIn connection request: must be 1-2 sentences, must NOT say 'I'd love to connect', must reference a specific trigger (the post or job posting). For the pipeline entry: must include required columns (Lead Name, Company, Source, Stage, Next Action) using valid stage names from SKILL.md's stage list (Identified/Contacted/etc.).
